basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old software engineer based in San Jose, CA. I'm passionate about gaming and exploring new experiences in life, both online and offline. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my evenings diving into virtual worlds or catching up on graphic novels. I'm a night owl, so you can usually find me online after 9 PM. I have a strong interest in tabletop RPGs and VR gaming, which often leads me to subreddits that cater to these hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which sparked my interest in technology and gaming. I've been gaming since I was a kid and have self-taught myself various programming languages to enhance my gaming experience. My knowledge extends to virtual reality platforms and RPG mechanics, often discussed in gaming communities.
